item.title: CQD-SHAP published by Springer
item.description: Our paper, CQD-SHAP: Explainable Complex Query Answering via Shapley Values, is now officially published in Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2026), Lecture Notes in Computer Science, by Springer. Read it on Springer.

item.title: CQD-SHAP preprint updated on arXiv
item.description: We updated our preprint CQD-SHAP: Explainable Complex Query Answering via Shapley Values on arXiv. The updated codebase to reproduce our experiments is also available on GitHub.

item.title: CQD-SHAP accepted at ECML PKDD 2026
item.description:
Our paper, CQD-SHAP: Explainable Complex Query Answering via Shapley Values, has been accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 in Naples, Italy. Joint work with Dr. Stefan Heindorf.

I will present the work on September 9 at 12:05 in the session “Structured Graphs, Causal & Relational Learning.” The poster session will take place the same day, from 7 to 9 PM.
